purpose: Teach: 殴ら/混沌/露骨/濫用/在留/誘発/解任/権益

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、暴力で殴られた患者の治療を医療チームで担当しました
lines.en: Ren, our medical team treated a patient who had been assaulted.
lines.style: Direct, clear opening. Steady professional register. Measured pace—this is difficult work but handled. Slight pause between thoughts to let gravity land without melodrama.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、災害時の混沌とした現場を医療チームで経験しました
lines.en: Yes, we worked through a chaotic disaster scene as a team.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Even tone—not minimizing the experience but not lingering on it either. Speaks from lived experience. Brief, grounded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 露骨な差別を受けた患者さんへの対応を貴院、なさったそうですね、先生
lines.en: I heard your hospital handled a patient facing blatant discrimination quite thoughtfully, Doctor.
lines.style: Respectful, genuinely curious. Lean forward slightly in posture—this matters to him. Careful enunciation of 'thoughtfully.' Not testing her, asking to learn.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、薬の濫用問題を医療チームで対策しております
lines.en: Yes, we're actively addressing substance abuse issues as a team.
lines.style: Steady continuation. Professional but warmed slightly—Ren's respect is visible to her. Same measured tempo. This is ongoing work, not a finished story.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 在留外国人の医療支援を貴院、なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital's support for resident foreign nationals—you've done that work, haven't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Soft admiration beneath the formality. Slight rise at the question mark—genuine asking, not rhetorical. Slower pace than before, giving weight to the question.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、ストレスが誘発する症状を医療チームで研究中です
lines.en: Yes, we're researching stress-induced symptoms across our team.
lines.style: Open but not expansive. Acknowledgment of complexity—this is active, difficult work. Slight breathiness suggesting the weight of ongoing investigation. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 院長解任の事件を貴院、ご経験されたそうですね、先生
lines.en: I understand your hospital faced a difficult situation with a director's removal. That must have been challenging.
lines.style: Careful, respectful. Not prying but acknowledging he knows something happened. Slower, more deliberate. Gives her space to respond or decline.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の医療権益を医療チームで守ります
lines.en: Yes, protecting our patients' medical rights is something we're committed to as a team.
lines.style: Firm but not defensive. The 'yes' lands with quiet conviction. Returns to the through-line of the conversation—this is what matters. Slight exhale before the final clause, settling into core values.
